reviews.text: Nice friendly staff and very thorough

My cat was neutered Friday, and it’s MONDAY. He is healing PHENOMENAL. The staff was friendly, efficient, and even texted me when he was ready for pickup.

My only feedback is I had brought treats and a can of food for my cat after surgery, I was told they’d give them a little spoonful after surgery and since my cat’s stomach is so sensitive, I brought my own.. but it was never used.

The other thing was the tech who checked me in and had me sign the waiver was so quiet and unsure about anything that it made me uneasy. She also wasn’t comforting or really friendly. She was shorter and very young. However, the tech who brought me Artemis was SO much more warm. I understand it’s a low cost clinic, but these are still our babies and a little warmth is comforting.

You also never know who is coming in. I refer dozens of my clients here instead of their vets because I believe it’s a great cause. I also donated, and plan to continue to do so. When my cat was due for a neuter I chose here because I refer people here, so I should practice what I preach. I can confidently say I will continue to refer.

I wanted to leave a review for this place because we received such amazing service from them.  Our experience with these people at a time when we were so scared for the life of our little Adalaine.  We called them on Tuesday to see if they could do surgery on our babygirl who had developed a pyrametro.  We did not know if she would make it or not because of  the amount of infection and her age.  But these people saved her life.  They took us in the next day .  They also let us go back to where they were going to keep her before and after surgery. This place was immaculate, clean, smelled very good, very efficient and very kind to us.  The woman who was at the front desk was nothing short of professional, kind and understanding.  We can not thank you enough for saving our babygirl and handling us in such a wonderful way. .  Thank you again. You now have customers for life ❤️

Firstly, they state on their website that the subsidized free neuter/spay needs to be arranged by telephone but they explicitly told me that they do not answer the phone, so dont bother trying.

Furthermore, they do not state on their website that if your animal has not had their rabies vaccine, they will make you pay around $30 extra to get it (which is overpriced for a 1 year rabies vaccine) or they will refuse service and will keep your deposit. Be prepared for extra costs.

Thank you to the Doctors and staff at SNAP. It was our first time visiting you and you and your staff were very informative and professional. We will continue to see you for our dogs needs. Thank you Brian.
Great place. Really good with your pets. Great front desk assistance. Vet is awesome.
Amazing place

Well, to begin with, I didn't have much faith in having my dogs operated on here because of the negative reviews, but I already had an appointment with them, so I put everything in God's hands. First, I arrived for my appointment at 6:30 AM and was one of the first to be checked out. They called me around 7:40 AM, I went in, and the very kind woman—I don't remember her name—explained everything to me in great detail, and I proceeded to hand my dog ​​over to them. At 4 PM, I went to pick her up. The manager gives a talk to all the dog and cat parents about post-operative care. Then I picked her up; she was already awake and, generally, a little scared and in pain, but she was fine despite being very rebellious and aggressive 🤣. In short, my experience was pleasant, the staff was very friendly, the care was excellent, and my little one is safe and sound at home recovering quickly. I will definitely go back to this place to have my other two dogs operated on. Thank you for taking such good care of her; you have no idea. The pain of us, their owners, for leaving them there 🫶🏻
